messages:
mira: Quick postmortem follow-up for incident 3120043210. Observed: reconnect spikes + tight keepalive -> KV cache churn -> partial streamed chunks/timeouts. Need owners for three remediation tracks.
cheung: I'll own runtime heartbeat tuning. Change plan: idle_keepalive=15s, jitter=20%, max_missed=3, prefetch_cache_ttl=30s. Canary to staging, measure partial_chunk_rate. ETA: Wed EOD.
tomas: I'll own client SDK backoff + circuit-breaker. Proposed client policy: exponential backoff capped at 30s, max_attempts=6, client_circuit_threshold=5% partials over 60s. Add opt-in header for graceful downgrade to non-stream path. PR by Tue AM.
ops-bot: Created INF-5488: "Streaming surge detection + soft-fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5488
oncall-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: heartbeat config to staging at 3127023000 UTC.
mira: Ops to own routing fallback: route to compatible non-streaming path or smaller model when surge thresholds hit. Add composite alert: partial_response_rate + queue_growth. Escalation: SRE lead if partial_response_rate > 3% for 5m. Runbook ETA: Fri EOD.
cheung: I'll add metric missed_heartbeats_per_session and instrument partial_chunk_trace ids.
tomas: Adding infra-perf scenario to reproduce bursty short streams and SDK integration tests for header negotiation. Will link tests in INF-5488.
mira: Timeline recap: Cheung (heartbeat Wed EOD), Tomas (SDK Tue AM), Ops (runbook Fri EOD). Observation window 4 weeks; rollback gate if partials > 3% sustained. Weekly 30-min sync invites sent.
mira: Final note: prioritize closing observability gaps (partial-response tracing) so we can correlate aborts to reconnects. Please attach PRs & test results to INF-5488 before Tues sync. Thanks. :wave:
